name: cmsis-developer-assistant
description: Enable AI coding agents to manage and extend CMSIS projects, with a set of AI skills and MCP server to interface to build and debug.

cmsis-developer-assistant.timeoutInSecon.description: Timeout in seconds for debugging operations

cmsis-developer-assistant.serverPort.description: Port number for the CMSIS Developer Assistant server

cmsis-developer-assistant.installedSkill.markdownDescription: The AI Skills Pack skills — the Open-CMSIS-Pack [cmsis-skills](https://github.com/Open-CMSIS-Pack/cmsis-skills) skills and their per-category entry points `cmsis-project`, `cmsis-bring-up`, `cmsis-pack` — to copy into your personal skills directories: `~/.agents/skills` always, `~/.claude/skills` when Claude Code is installed, `$COPILOT_HOME/skills` when that variable is set. Pick them with **CMSIS Developer Assistant: Select Agent Skills**. An entry point gives the agent one slash command for the whole category; skills a selected skill depends on are installed too, hidden from the slash menu. The extension's own `cmsis-debug-live` and `cmsis-help` are always installed and need not be listed. Deselected skills that this extension installed are removed; skills you installed yourself are never touched. Has no effect while `#cmsis-developer-assistant.aiSkills.enabled#` is off.

cmsis-developer-assistant.aiSkills.enabl.markdownDescription: Enable the AI Skills Pack for selected agents: the Open-CMSIS-Pack [cmsis-skills](https://github.com/Open-CMSIS-Pack/cmsis-skills) skills and their per-category entry points (`cmsis-project`, `cmsis-bring-up`, `cmsis-pack`). When disabled, the pack skills this extension installed are removed from your skills directories (skills you installed yourself are never touched), the skills step of the setup is skipped and no install prompt is shown; the extension's own skills (`cmsis-debug-live`, `cmsis-help`) stay installed and your `#cmsis-developer-assistant.installedSkills#` selection is kept for re-enabling.

cmsis-developer-assistant.aiSkills.promp.markdownDescription: Prompt to install the CMSIS AI Skills for selected agents — the agents that have the CMSIS Developer Assistant MCP server registered — at most once a month, until you add a skill from the pack. *Don't ask again* in the prompt turns this off.

cmsis-developer-assistant.redactSecrets.markdownDescription: Withhold variable and expression values whose name or content looks like a credential (API key, token, password, connection string) before they are sent to an AI agent. Numeric scalars are never withheld, so firmware flags and counters named `auth`, `token` or `key` stay readable. Raw target reads — `read_memory`, `read_core_registers`, `read_peripheral_register`, `get_fault_info`, and `-exec` GDB passthrough — are never redacted.

cmsis-developer-assistant.dapRequestTime.description: Per-request timeout (in milliseconds) for DAP traffic to the debug adapter / hardware probe. If the probe or GDB server stalls, requests will fail with a HardwareTimeoutError instead of hanging the MCP tool call. Increase for slow targets or large memory reads.

cmsis-developer-assistant.memoryReadTime.description: Overall timeout (in milliseconds) for a single read_memory / read_core_registers tool call. Caps the total time spent talking to the hardware, even across many word-level fallback reads.

cmsis-developer-assistant.telemetry.json.markdownDescription: Append one JSON line per MCP tool call — tool name, argument and result size in bytes, duration, outcome — to this file, for offline analysis of what an agent session costs. Empty (the default) keeps the file off; the in-memory statistics behind `get_session_status` and the `cmsis-developer-assistant://stats` resource are always kept. A relative path is resolved against the first workspace folder. Read once at activation: changing it needs a window reload. The file records names and sizes only, never tool arguments or results.

cmsis-developer-assistant.serial.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer the `serial_*` tools (UART ports and the Serial Monitor) to AI agents. Off removes the ten serial tools from the MCP tool list, which every agent turn carries — worth it when your workflow never reads a UART. Read once at activation: changing it needs a window reload, and it applies to the next agent connection.

cmsis-developer-assistant.packDocs.enabl.markdownDescription: **Experimental** — the documentation system is new and its tools, arguments and output may change between releases. Offer the documentation tools to AI agents: `list_target_docs`, `search_target_docs`, `read_doc_pages`, `fetch_doc`, `get_peripheral_docs` — page-cited search over the reference manuals, datasheets, errata and board manuals the current csolution target's DFP/BSP ship or link, plus Arm documents, your own imported manuals and the workspace `docs/` folder. Adds five tools to the MCP tool list every agent turn carries; PDFs are indexed with the bundled pdf.js (poppler optional, see `packDocs.extractor`). Read once at activation: changing it needs a window reload.

cmsis-developer-assistant.packDocs.extra.markdownDescription: PDF text extractor. `pdfjs` is bundled and needs nothing installed (what `auto` uses); `pdftotext` uses poppler from the PATH or `packDocs.pdftotextPath`. Switching re-extracts documents on their next use.

cmsis-developer-assistant.packDocs.pdfto.description: Executable name or path of pdftotext, used when packDocs.extractor is pdftotext.

cmsis-developer-assistant.packDocs.maxPd.description: PDFs larger than this (in MB) are listed but not indexed.

cmsis-developer-assistant.packDocs.inclu.description: Also list PDFs found inside the device/board pack that no <book> element references.

cmsis-developer-assistant.packDocs.works.markdownDescription: Folders (relative to each workspace folder) whose PDFs are listed and searched together with the target's pack documents — the drop folder for a datasheet or manual the packs do not ship.

cmsis-developer-assistant.packDocs.userD.markdownDescription: Folder for documents the packs do not ship (NDA manuals, portal downloads), outside any workspace and shared by every project; sub-folders attribute them to packs (`<Vendor>/<Pack>`), devices (`devices/<glob>`), boards (`boards/<name>`) or cores (`cores/<core>`). Empty: `~/.cmsis-pack-docs/user`. Fill it with **Import Document for Current Target**.

cmsis-developer-assistant.buildInfo.enab.markdownDescription: **Experimental** — the build-artefact tools are new and may change between releases. Offer the build-artefact tools to AI agents: `list_build_artifacts`, `get_memory_usage`, `lookup_symbol`, `get_section_layout`, `get_build_diagnostics` — the ELF, linker map and build log of the current csolution target, read deterministically. Adds five tools to the MCP tool list every agent turn carries. Read once at activation: changing it needs a window reload.

cmsis-developer-assistant.buildInfo.maxS.description: Symbols and objects listed by get_memory_usage and get_section_layout (the tool's top argument overrides it).

cmsis-developer-assistant.buildInfo.logG.markdownDescription: Workspace globs searched for build logs by `get_build_diagnostics` (newest first). Capture one with `cbuild … --log out/build.log`.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:transport: npm run compile && node test/transport/session-lifecycle.js && node test/transport/two-window-routing.js
